reason: Provides structured Git workflow tools for repository status, diffs, history, branches, staging, and local commit creation; its primary user-facing purpose is terminal-based repository management.

summaries.zh: 为模型提供结构化的 Git 工作流工具，用于查看仓库状态、差异、历史和分支，并在校验提交信息后暂存文件和创建本地提交。
summaries.en: Provides structured Git workflow tools for viewing repository status, diffs, history, and branches, as well as staging paths and creating local commits after validating messages.

capabilities: Read repository status, diffs, commit history, and local branches
Stage selected paths and create Git commits with validated messages
Execute Git commands through the harness shell executor
